mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.STATUS IN ('Y', 'R', 'N')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) WHERE M.STATUS IN ('Y', 'R', 'N')
AND M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND D.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND P.POSITION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ( (#{keyword} LIKE '%재%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'Y' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%휴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'R' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%퇴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%사%') AND M.STATUS = 'N' OR M.STATUS LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.LOGIN_PWD, M.NAME, M.EMAIL, M.PHONE, M.ADDRESS, M.HIRE_DATE, M.RETIRE_DATE, M.STATUS, M.DEPARTMENT_ID, M.POSITION_ID, M.ROLE, M.LEAVE_START_DATE, M.LEAVE_END_DATE, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PWD, NAME, DEPARTMENT_ID, POSITION_ID, HIRE_DATE, STATUS, EMAIL, PHONE, ADDRESS, ROLE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{loginId}, #{loginPwd}, #{name}, #{deptId}, #{positionId}, #{hireDate}, 'Y', #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT M.DEPARTMENT_ID, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) WHERE M.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY M.DEPARTMENT_ID
SELECT DISTINCT POSITION_ID AS "positionId", POSITION_NAME AS "positionName" FROM POSITION ORDER BY POSITION_ID
